scripts.ios: rm -rf ios/build ios/Pods ios/*.xcworkspace ios/Podfile.lock && cd ios && pod deintegrate 2>/dev/null; cd .. && npx react-native spm add --yes && cd ios && xcodebuild -project AdbrixReactNativeSdkExample.xcodeproj -scheme AdbrixReactNativeSdkExample -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -derivedDataPath build
scripts.build:ios: cd ios && xcodebuild -project AdbrixReactNativeSdkExample.xcodeproj -scheme AdbrixReactNativeSdkExample -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -derivedDataPath build
